key_terms.funding_rate: Fixed amounts by measure. Small wind: max EUR 140 per m2 of rotor area. Air-to-water heat pump 2026: EUR 225 per kW, from the first kW for the first unit; 2027: EUR 120 per kW. Other heat pump types unchanged. Solar boiler amount depends on aperture area and vessel size (trade press: EUR 0.55 per kW
key_terms.caps: Per-type heat pump amounts sit on RVO's conditions pages and registration-code list; not collected here
key_terms.window: Application through 31 Dec 2030 for heat pumps and solar boilers; through 31 Dec 2027 for small wind. The application date fixes the subsidy amount.
key_terms.before_start: Yes: apply before accepting a quote, reserving or installing; applications made afterwards are rejected
key_terms.status: OPEN: heat pumps and solar boilers through 31 Dec 2030; small wind turbines through 31 Dec 2027 (RVO page checked 26 Oct 2026). From 2027 the air-to-water heat pump amount falls from EUR 225 to EUR 120 per kW; applying on or before 31 Dec 2026 keeps 2026 conditions.

key_terms.funding_rate: Multi-year operating subsidy per unit of output, up to a base amount per technique (category base amounts sit on five category pages and are not collected here). Applications are ranked by subsidy intensity in EUR per tonne of CO2 avoided.
key_terms.caps: An application may not exceed the category's maximum base amount. Budget EUR 8bn, with EUR 750M ring-fenced for each of three domains: low-temperature heat, high-temperature heat, molecules (green gas, hydrogen).
key_terms.window: Five phases by subsidy intensity: EUR 75/t (27 Oct 09:00 to 2 Nov 17:00), EUR 150/t (to 9 Nov), EUR 225/t (to 16 Nov), EUR 300/t (to 23 Nov), EUR 400/t (to 26 Nov 17:00)
key_terms.before_start: Yes: no irreversible investment commitment for the installation (date the supply or installation contract is signed) before applying; preparation costs such as feasibility, permits, land and grid connection are allowed. Permits must already be held and attached.
key_terms.status: OPEN NOW: 27 Oct to 26 Nov 2026 17:00. Today (17 Nov) falls in phase 4 (up to EUR 300 per tonne, 16 Nov 17:00 to 23 Nov 17:00); phase 5 (up to EUR 400 per tonne) runs 23 Nov 17:00 to 26 Nov 17:00.

key_terms.funding_rate: No percentage rate is stated on the RVO page. Support is limited to the part of the investment that does not pay back within 5 years, and may not exceed EUR 80 per tonne of CO2 avoided over the first 15 years (or the asset's life if shorter).
key_terms.caps: Max EUR 30M per project; EUR 25M for specific hydrogen or waste-heat infrastructure and storage; EUR 11M for public hydrogen infrastructure (project costs max EUR 22M). Minimum subsidy EUR 125,000 for a large company, EUR 30,000 for an SME.
key_terms.before_start: Yes: no start of work (construction, irreversible orders or commitments) before the application is filed; start within 6 months of the grant and finish within 4 years
key_terms.status: OPEN, but RVO says the budget is oversubscribed (page checked 13 Oct 2026): 7 May 2026 to 28 Jan 2027 17:00. Applications are still accepted because budget can free up when others are rejected; handled in order of arrival.
